name: open-business-plan-monorepo
description: An open source JSON Schema defining a business plan, with TypeScript and Python packages that parse and validate it.

scripts.build: npm run sync:schema && npm --workspace @invisra/open-business-plan run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: cd packages/python && ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy
